question: Where did India win its last Olympic medal in men’s hockey? (As of March, 2024).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tokyo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India won its last Olympic medal in men’s hockey at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
• The Indian men's hockey team clinched the **bronze medal** after defeating Germany 5-4.
 
• This victory marked the end of a **41-year medal drought** in men's field hockey for India at the Olympics.
 
• The medal win at Tokyo 2020 was India's **12th Olympic medal** in men’s hockey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Games**

 
 
• The Olympic Games are a leading international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
 
• The Games are considered the world's foremost sports competition and are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.
 
 
 
• **Men's Field Hockey**
 
 
• Field hockey is a team sport of the hockey family, which is played on grass, watered turf, artificial turf, or synthetic field, as well as an indoor boarded surface.
 
• India has a rich history in men's field hockey, having won numerous medals in past Olympic Games, including eight gold medals.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**
 
 
• The Tokyo 2020 Olympics were originally scheduled to take place in 2020 but were postponed to 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• This edition of the Olympics saw significant safety protocols and restrictions due to the ongoing pandemic.
